memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel's army,
withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and
stood behind them, coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the
night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so
neither went near the other all night long." - Ex 14:19-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The pillar that had been leading them now moves to stand between them and the
enemy.

Think about what that means. For weeks it had gone ahead, showing the way. Now
God repositions Himself according to the need. When they needed direction, He
was in front. When they needed protection, He was behind.

That is a picture worth keeping. Isaiah 52:12 says, "the LORD will go before
you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard." Both. He leads and He covers.

Notice what the same cloud did on each side. Darkness to the Egyptians, light to
Israel. One presence, two completely different experiences. God's presence is not
neutral. To those sheltering in Him it is light; to those set against Him it is
darkness.

Paul says something similar about the gospel itself: to some it is the fragrance
of life, to others the smell of death (2 Cor 2:15-16). The message is the same.
The difference is which side of the cloud you are standing on.

And notice the mercy of the timing. All night, God simply held the enemy back.
Sometimes God's protection looks like nothing happening at all.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you need God in front of you or behind you right now?
2. Can you see a time when God's protection looked like nothing happening?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, be my guide and my rear guard. Thank You that You stand between me and
what I cannot handle. Amen.
